responsibility: Implements the RISC-V backend’s target builtin layer for scalar machine-dependent builtins. It defines the builtin description table, maps prototype enums from riscv-ftypes.def to GCC tree function types, registers available `__builtin_riscv_*` functions through `TARGET_INIT_BUILTINS`, returns declarations via `TARGET_BUILTIN_DECL`, and expands builtin calls to RTL by driving named `.md` instruction codes and operand preparation in `TARGET_EXPAND_BUILTIN`; it also provides the RISC-V implementation of `TARGET_ATOMIC_ASSIGN_EXPAND_FENV` by wiring atomic floating-environment save/clear sequences to the `frflags` and `fsflags` builtins.
